# ONNX Runtime Web

Version: 1.27.0

Source: <https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime>

License: MIT

Only the WebAssembly entry module, matching WebAssembly glue module, and
matching SIMD WebAssembly binary required by the SDE local handwriting worker
are vendored here. Their SHA-256 hashes are pinned in the SDE HTR model
manifest.
